summary: Pin toolchain go1.26.5 in go.mod to clear reachable stdlib CVE GO-2026-5856 (crypto/tls ECH privacy leak).
reason: The generator emitted 'go 1.26.4', which govulncheck flags for GO-2026-5856 (reachable via the MCP HTTPS server and reachability probe). go1.26.5 fixes it; the toolchain directive makes publish-time govulncheck analyze against the patched stdlib without a GOTOOLCHAIN env dependency.
validated_outcome: publish validate govulncheck: No vulnerabilities found.
